title.value: Substituting Data Annotation with Balanced Updates and Collective Loss in Multi-label Text Classification
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the information provided in the paper citation and is a standard approach to identifying academic papers.
title.quote: Citation: Ozmen, M. Cotnareanu, J. and Coates, M. Substituting Data Annotation with Balanced Updates and Collective Loss in Multi-label Text Classification. Proc. Conf. Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), 2023.

analysis.description: The paper presents a framework for multi-label text classification that operates effectively in scenarios with limited or no annotation. It leverages pre-trained language models and develops a method to incorporate label dependencies and weak supervision signals to enhance classification performance, specifically in annotation-free and scarce-annotation settings. The proposed method demonstrates significant improvements over baseline models in example-based F1 score.

type.justification: The paper involves experiments with datasets and reports empirical results on various metrics across multiple settings, indicating an empirical study.
type.quote: Our experiments show that the proposed framework is efficient and effective in terms of improving the prediction performance.
